chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from his father, from Abu al-Bakhtari, raising it (to the Prophet), said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'O Allah! Bless us in the bread, and do not Cause separation between us and it, for had there not been for the bread, neither would we have (been able to) Fast, nor Pray, nor fulfill the Obligations of our Lord, Mighty and Majestic'.
ai.seo_question: Why is bread considered essential for performing Islamic worship according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Shia scholarly view that physical sustenance is the foundational prerequisite for spiritual devotion, linking the material necessity of bread directly to the capacity for fasting and prayer. It reflects the concept of 'tawassul' through basic needs, illustrating how the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) grounded metaphysical obligations in earthly realities, a theme often discussed in discussions of 'fitrah' and human dependency on Allah's provision.
